messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

It has a black head with yellow-orange sides of the neck and upper chest, a white feathered front, and a tan back and flippers densely covered with black spots like a leopard. It has a long pointed black beak, large scaly clawed feet, and a short black feathered tail at the rear.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "rounded black feathered head like a penguin with a yellow patch on the side of the neck", "part": "head", "where": "at the top front of the body"}, {"looks_like": "long slender pointed black beak", "part": "beak", "where": "on the front of the head pointing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "small round dark eye", "part": "eye", "where": "on the side of the head"}, {"looks_like": "large upright oval body with dense fluffy white plumage on the front and tan spotted plumage on the back", "part": "body", "where": "in the center forming the main torso from neck to legs"}, {"looks_like": "short flattened flipper covered in tan fur-like feathers with black spots", "part": "wings", "where": "on the side of the body, one clearly visible along the right side of the torso"}, {"looks_like": "short feather-covered limbs leading down to the feet", "part": "legs", "where": "at the bottom of the body above the feet"}, {"looks_like": "large scaly gray bird feet with three forward toes and black claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the bottom supporting the body on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "short pointed tail made of black feathers", "part": "tail", "where": "at the lower rear of the body pointing down and left"}, {"looks_like": "dense black spots on a tan background like a leopard, plus a yellow to orange wash on the sides of the neck and upper chest", "part": "markings", "where": "the spots cover the entire back, tail base and flippers, with the yellow on the neck and chest"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "tails": 1, "walking_legs": 2, "wings": 1}
